svg.title: Full neural network summary: architecture and matrix math on black background
svg.desc: Combined diagram showing 4-3-2-1 neural network architecture with all edges, followed by complete layer-by-layer matrix operations including sigmoid activations, on a black background.
svg.text: Neural network — architecture + full forward pass | 4 → 3 → 2 → 1
W rows = next layer size · W cols = current layer size → W¹(3×4) W²(2×3) W³(1×2)
Transition 1 — input (4) → hidden layer 1 (3) | W¹ is (3 × 4)
Step 2 : a¹ = σ(z¹) — sigmoid applied element-wise
σ(z) = 1 / (1 + e⁻ᶻ) squashes any real number into (0, 1)
Transition 2 — hidden layer 1 (3) → hidden layer 2 (2) | W² is (2 × 3)
Step 2 : a² = σ(z²) — sigmoid applied element-wise
Transition 3 — hidden layer 2 (2) → output (1) | W³ is (1 × 2)
Step 2 : ŷ = σ(z³) — final scalar output, a single number in (0, 1)
ŷ = σ( W³ · σ( W² · σ( W¹ · x + b¹ ) + b² ) + b³ )
innermost σ fires first → (3×1) → W² → (2×1) → W³ → scalar ŷ ∈ (0,1)
